note: Where every method of the old src/db.js landed in src/db/, and why. Written by the split so the cut can be checked instead of re-derived.
rule: The mixin is the DDL family of a method dominant table, taken from the src/sql/ file prefix (order_matches.sql and orders.sql are both the orders family). A method with no SQL stays on index.js. A method whose table is a caller-supplied parameter belongs to no family and goes to misc.js. Anything that does not follow from the dominant table carries its reason in the why field.
scoring: A write target (INSERT/REPLACE INTO, UPDATE, DELETE FROM, CREATE/ALTER TABLE) scores 10, the FROM table 5, a JOIN 1; an index_* lookup table is weighted at a fifth so a join for an id does not outrank the table being read.
install: db/index.js lists every mixin in MIXIN_FILES and installs it with Object.defineProperties(Database.prototype, ..., enumerable:false), which is what the class body produced: 470 own prototype names, none enumerable.
